tagline: Teddy fleece up for winter, smooth canvas up for summer: one bed, flipped with the season.
lead: Your dog gets teddy fleece when it's cold and smooth canvas when it's warm, from the same bed.
value: It's two beds in one, and the one you aren't using isn't taking up space in a cupboard.
intro: Hare is a reversible square dog bed, 80 × 80cm, with teddy fleece on one face and smooth-weave canvas on the other, under a removable zipped cover.
points: Teddy fleece on one side, smooth canvas on the other. Flip it with the season.
80 × 80cm suits dogs who sleep curled or diagonally rather than stretched in a line.
They can get on from any edge and lie whichever way they like.
It comes off for washing, following the sewn-in care label.
best_for: Dogs who burrow into anything soft in winter but head for the kitchen tiles in summer, and who sleep curled or diagonally.
fit_note: The whole square is usable. It suits dogs who curl or sleep diagonally; for a dog who stretches out in a straight line, a rectangular mattress will suit better.
care: Unzip the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting.
seo_title: Reversible Fleece & Canvas Dog Bed, 80cm Square | Snoozly
seo_description: A reversible dog bed for the whole year: teddy fleece for winter, smooth canvas for summer. 80 × 80cm square with no walls and a removable zipped cover.
